# Synthetic fixture (INF10-01): storage resources with no lifecycle/retention declared.
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
Resources:
  UploadsBucket:
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "uploads-${Stage}"
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: expire-old
            Status: Disabled
            ExpirationInDays: 30
          - Id: to-glacier
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 90
  StagingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: abort-uploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
  ReportsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: old-versions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: expire-current
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
  AppLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/app/${Stage}"
  ImageRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: app
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
  Handler:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      CodeUri: src/
